newsitem.title: INDIA: Mother Teresa successor vote within 10 days -- order.
newsitem.headline: Mother Teresa successor vote within 10 days -- order.

text.p: The delayed election to find a successor to Mother Teresa at the head of her Roman Catholic order will be held within the next ten days, a spokeswoman for the Missionaries of Charity said on Monday.

"The election process is on and is likely to be completed by end-February or early next month, " the spokeswoman told Reuters. "The deliberations will be completed soon. Please wait for another ten days."
